content.text:
The test passes. 

The change request — filter projects by active/on hold/finished — is implemented. It turned out the full-stack foundation was already in place (the `projects.status` column via migration `V17`, the seed support for `status`, and the `/api/projects` response carrying `status`), so the change was purely the missing filter UI, added additively:

- **`features/projects/status-filter.slot.tsx`** (new) — a self-contained `<select data-testid="project-status-filter">` filling the projects toolbar slot (`order: 30`), offering All statuses / Active / On hold / Finished. It owns the `status` URL search param.
- **`features/projects/queries.ts`** — added the shared `PROJECTS_STATUS_FILTER_PARAM = 'status'` constant so the filter and the list agree on the key without importing each other.
- **`features/projects/ProjectsTable.tsx`** — reads the same `status` param and adds one more `.filter(...)` in the existing filter chain (alongside the archived/tag filters).

No callbacks, no shared component state — the filter and the list stay in step through the URL key, per the CLAUDE.md conventions.
